raw_text:
PLAN "Couch to 5K with Strength, Pace, Intervals, Tempo, Parkrun Test for Asthma (12 Weeks) - Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary endurance:
    name "Complete a 5K run safely"
  GOAL secondary strength:
    name "Build foundational strength for running"
  GOAL secondary speed:
    name "Improve running pace and interval capacity"
  GOAL secondary tempo:
    name "Develop sustained tempo running ability"
  GOAL secondary assessment:
    name "Test 5K performance at week 8"

PHASES
  PHASE "Summary" (12 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      Monday: Walk/run intervals (short, easy)
      Wednesday: Walk/run intervals (short, easy)
      Thursday: Strength foundation (squat, glute_bridge, push_up, plank)
      Saturday: Walk/run intervals (short, easy)
    WEEK 2:
      Monday: Walk/run intervals (slightly longer)
      Wednesday: Walk/run intervals (slightly longer)
      Thursday: Strength foundation (progressed reps)
      Saturday: Walk/run intervals (slightly longer)
    WEEK 3:
      Monday: Walk/run intervals (progressing duration)
      Wednesday: Walk/run intervals (progressing duration)
      Thursday: Strength foundation (progressed sets/reps)
      Saturday: Walk/run intervals (progressing duration)
    WEEK 4:
      Monday: Walk/run intervals (progressing duration)
      Wednesday: Walk/run intervals (progressing duration)
      Thursday: Strength foundation (progressed sets/reps)
      Saturday: Walk/run intervals (progressing duration)
    WEEK 5:
      Monday: Walk/run intervals (longer)
      Wednesday: Interval introduction (short intervals, moderate pace)
      Thursday: Strength progression (higher reps)
      Saturday: Tempo intro (short tempo efforts)
    WEEK 6:
      Monday: Walk/run intervals (longer)
      Wednesday: Interval progression (more intervals)
      Thursday: Strength progression (higher reps)
      Saturday: Tempo progression (longer tempo efforts)
    WEEK 7:
      Monday: Walk/run intervals (longer)
      Wednesday: Interval progression (more intervals)
      Thursday: Strength progression (higher reps)
      Saturday: Tempo progression (longer tempo efforts)
    WEEK 8:
      Monday: Walk/run intervals (longer)
      Wednesday: Interval progression (longer intervals)
      Thursday: Strength progression (higher reps)
      Saturday: Parkrun 5K test (first full 5K run)
    WEEK 9:
      Monday: Longer run intervals (continuous running)
      Wednesday: Pace intervals (moderate/hard pace)
      Thursday: Strength maintenance (lower volume)
      Friday: Tempo run (sustained effort)
      Saturday: Interval progression (longer intervals)
    WEEK 10:
      Monday: Longer run intervals (continuous running)
      Wednesday: Pace intervals (moderate/hard pace)
      Thursday: Strength maintenance (lower volume)
      Friday: Tempo run (sustained effort)
      Saturday: Interval progression (longer intervals)
    WEEK 11:
      Monday: Continuous run build (longest continuous run so far)
      Wednesday: Pace intervals (harder pace)
      Thursday: Strength maintenance (lower volume)
      Friday: Tempo run (longer sustained effort)
      Saturday: Interval progression (longer intervals)
    WEEK 12:
      Monday: Continuous run (longest continuous run)
      Wednesday: Pace intervals (hardest pace)
      Thursday: Strength maintenance (lower volume)
      Friday: Tempo run (longest sustained effort)
      Saturday: 5K run attempt (race simulation)
